name: Williamsburg & Virginia Beach
summary: The Historic Triangle — colonial Williamsburg, Jamestown, and Yorktown — plus a theme park and the oceanfront at Virginia Beach.

lodging.name: A Colonial Williamsburg inn
lodging.blurb: Stay inside the historic area for the full effect.

foodMustTry.name: Colonial tavern fare
foodMustTry.blurb: Peanut soup and Sally Lunn bread in an 18th-century tavern.

item.title: Colonial Williamsburg
item.blurb: The largest living-history museum in the country — costumed tradespeople, the Capitol, and the Governor's Palace.

days.label: Day 155 — Jamestown & Yorktown
days.summary: The first settlement and the decisive victory.

item.title: Jamestown Settlement
item.blurb: The first permanent English colony (1607) — recreated fort, ships, and Powhatan village.

item.title: Yorktown Battlefield
item.blurb: Where Washington's victory in 1781 effectively ended the Revolution.

rest.label: Colonial evening
rest.note: Three consecutive days of the eighteenth century is a lot of the eighteenth century. Walk Duke of Gloucester Street after the tour groups have gone — it is a completely different place empty and lit by lanterns.

days.label: Day 156 — Virginia Beach
days.summary: The oceanfront and the first landing.

item.title: Virginia Beach boardwalk & First Landing
item.blurb: A three-mile boardwalk and the cape where the first Jamestown colonists came ashore.

days.label: Day 157 — South to the Outer Banks
days.summary: Down to North Carolina's barrier islands.

commute.scenicNote: South across the state line onto the Outer Banks.
